description: This file contains utility functions for working with PyTorch FX graphs, including topological sorting, validation of graph partitions, node fusion into submodules, insertion of subgraphs, and node erasure. It appears to support graph transformations for optimization or modifications within the PyTorch FX framework.

methods.name: NodeList topo_sort(nodes: NodeList)
methods.description: Sorts a list of FX nodes in topological order based on their data dependencies.

methods.name: bool validate_partition(partition: NodeList)
methods.description: Checks if a list of nodes forms a dependency cycle within the graph, ensuring the partition is valid.

methods.name: tuple[GraphModule,tuple[Node,...],tuple[Node,...]] fuse_as_graphmodule( gm: GraphModule, nodes: NodeList, module_name: str, partition_lookup_table: _Optional[dict[Node, _Optional[int]]] = None, *, always_return_tuple: bool = False, )
methods.description: Fuses a set of FX nodes into a subgraph encapsulated as a new GraphModule, with optional partition lookup.

methods.name: GraphModule insert_subgm( gm: GraphModule, sub_gm: GraphModule, orig_inputs: tuple[Node, ...], orig_outputs: tuple[Node, ...], )
methods.description: Inserts a subgraph (sub GraphModule) into a parent GraphModule at the appropriate position.

methods.name: None erase_nodes(gm: GraphModule, nodes: NodeList)
methods.description: Removes specified nodes from the FX graph in reverse topological order.

methods.name: GraphModule fuse_by_partitions( gm: GraphModule, partitions: list[dict[Node, _Optional[int]]], prefix: str = "fused_", always_return_tuple: bool = False, )
methods.description: Performs node fusion across multiple partitions, creating submodules for each partition and replacing them in the parent graph.
